title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 1 (Duration)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2020, s. 9; am. B.C. Regs. 83/2022; 110/2023, s. 13.] Restrictions on High Risk Activities Item Column 1 Fire Danger Class (DGR) Column 2 Restriction Column 3
Duration
1 III (moderate) After 3 consecutive days of DGR III or greater, maintain a fire watcher immediately after the high risk activity ends for a minimum of one hour
